verdict.rationale: Qualcomm provides multiple official SDKs and tooling for AI-native development on Snapdragon X2 Elite hardware — the AI Engine Direct SDK, Qualcomm AI Hub (model conversion, quantization, profiling on real devices), and the open-source GenieX runtime/toolkit for deploying Gen AI models with few lines of code, plus sample app repos and 300+ pre-optimized models. This directly satisfies the 'build against official SDKs' story for on-device AI development. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of these SDKs in practice, and no OpenAPI/machine-readable docs were found via probes (developer.md 404, no openapi.json).
